title: Backend Task
description: Schema for an atomic task block delivered to Agente04_DevBackend from Agente03_SoftwareEngineer via the Execution Plan.

task_id.description: Unique task identifier from the Execution Plan.

type.description: The primary implementation type required for this task.

file_path.description: Target file path where the implementation should be created or modified.

function_signatures.description: Expected function signatures or API shapes to implement.

examples: export async function createTask(rawInput: unknown): Promise<Task>
export async function GET(req: NextRequest): Promise<NextResponse>

acceptance_criteria.description: List of testable acceptance criteria that define when this task is complete.
examples: Returns created task with id when valid input provided
Throws Unauthorized when session is null
Throws ZodError when title is empty string
Records audit_log entry after successful creation

roles_allowed.description: If role-restricted, which roles are allowed. Empty means any authenticated user.

ownership_check_required.description: Whether the requesting user must own the resource being accessed/mutated.

audit_required.description: Whether audit_log entry is required for this operation.

test_requirements.description: Test coverage requirements for this task.

test_file_path.description: Path where the test file should be created.

minimum_test_cases.description: Minimum number of test cases. Default is 4 (unauthenticated, invalid input, success, error).

required_scenarios.description: Specific test scenarios that must be covered.

depends_on.description: Task IDs that must be completed before this task can start.

api_contract_reference.description: Reference to the relevant section of API_Contract.json (path or endpoint ID).

db_schema_reference.description: Reference to the relevant Prisma model(s) used by this task.

notes.description: Additional context, constraints, or special instructions for implementation.
